sources.title: tailot/universal-upscale-distilled · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the distilled variant. The non-distilled model — one arbitrary-scale checkpoint that handles any factor from 2x to 9.2x — lives at tailot/universal-upscale. Use that one when you need a free scale factor; use this one when you want a tiny, fast, fixed 9x model that runs anywhere ONNX Runtime runs.
